BreakIn cremental Pixel Sprites

Pachinko lamp look as pixel art on a 2× canvas (640×360). One sprite pixel is two screen pixels in game. Sizes below are native pixels. Glow in-engine comes from a shader; the bumpers in the mockup show what nearest-neighbour rotation does to pixel art.

Zoom

Animations

370 animations looping at the frame rate noted. The strip under each is the exported sprite sheet; held frames are repeated in the strip, in-engine they would be a hold time instead. Grouped as in docs/animations.md.
